Author: Serpens66
Name: Building Limit
Description: Limits the number of active buildings per kind for human players in Stronghold Crusader Definitive Edition.

Changes: Updated shared lobby settings for Script Extender 1.42.0 by avoiding redundant UI-only persistence and using the official multiplayer-game signal.
Added optional Serps Mods Host dependency for Workshop mod-pack load ordering.
Made Script Extender initialization process-wide and race-safe, and removed the obsolete scan implementation.
Highlighted the activation control and standardized larger, wider settings tooltips.
Standardized the Host settings layout, corrected German labels, and added opaque wrapping tooltips.
Delegated optional mission-preset coordination to CustomCustomTrail; local presets remain standalone.
Added mission-bound Trail presets from .modjson and CustomCustomTrail schema-2 missions, including shared customization UI.
Added two automatically saved lobby-settings presets with migration of existing settings to preset 1.
